definitions.text: heldig hendelse eller omstendighet som demper virkningen av en ugunstig hendelse
definitions.translation: a fortunate event or circumstance that lessens the effect of an adverse event (lit. luck in misfortune)

examples.no: det var hell i uhell at de var hjemme da det begynte å brenne
examples.en: It was fortunate, amid the misfortune, that they were home when the fire started.
